title: Triggering multiple events if player interacted with previously

posts.author: PapatronTCAP
posts.body:
Hello all,
I am trying to script a quest in RPG Maker MZ:
There are objects A, B, C and D
The player interacts with objects A and B.
The player goes to tell the quest giver.
Objects A and B disappear, but not objects C and D.
Is there a way to set this up?
Any advise would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you very much!

posts.author: B3N4ZC4L
posts.body:
Well you could make use of Self Switches and add an empty page into your event that requires the Self Switch you choose.
Depending on how you do it, you can make either Object A & B disappear upon clearing the quest, or you'll make either Object A or Object B disappear, depending on how you'd like to do that.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
There are so many ways to do this... You could have A and B give the player a hidden dummy item that the npc checks for.
Make a second empty event page on A and B with the condition of either 1 or 2 switches, depending on whether or not the player can talk to npc when only having interacted with one of the events. At npc you then make 2 or a nested conditional branch (again depending on whether or not the player can talk to npc when only having interacted with one of the events.)
In those branches you check if player has "hidden item A" then immediately inside that you check for if player has "Hidden Item B". If true, turn on the switch or both switches and now A and B vanish.
